comparison.objective: Roll a fallen robot dog off its legs, remove its battery, and place it on a charger; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body reorientation, stabilization, battery extraction, and transfer; no rotary adjustment or setscrew retention.
comparison.success_condition: Battery must be removed and placed on the charging pad. The body lacks detailed scoring, safety thresholds, and spec versions.
comparison.reason: Tests access creation and component removal from an unstable assembly, not tuning.
